name: Potent Breath Weapon [Breath]
body:
You have trained to keep your breath weapon potent, regardless of how you use it.

Prerequisite(s): Draconic breath weapon racial trait.

Benefit(s): Whenever you use a feat or ability which would reduce the damage die of your breath weapon by 1 or more steps, you ignore 1 step of the reduction (For example, if you used the Advanced Breath Weapon feat while you possessed this feat, the damage of your breath weapon would be reduced by 1 step instead of 2). At 8th level and again at 16th level, you may ignore an additional reduction to your breath weapon’s damage die.

Legendary Races: Wyrmtouched © 2018, Legendary Games; Authors: N. Jolly, Amber Underwood, Siobhan Bjorknas, and Loren Sieg.
